description: Application under Section 73 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 to carry out development without compliance with Condition 1 (Approved drawings) of planning permission ref: 25/00694/HOU. Variation to consist of an increase in the height of the single storey rear extension due to roof and parapet changes.
decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates shall be carried out in accordance with the materials specified on the approved plans and on the submitted application form unless otherwise agreed in writing by the local planning authority.Reason: To ensure a satisfactory appearance on completion of the development, in accordance with Policy D3 of the London Plan 2021 and Policies CS8 and DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

A minimum of 3 swift bricks must be incorporated within the external walls of the development hereby approved prior to occupation and must be retained thereafter.Reason: To enhance the biodiversity of the site in accordance with the Kingston Swift (Flagship) Species Action Plan (2023), Policy DM6 of the Kingston Core Strategy (2012) and Policy G6 of the London Plan (2021).
Expiry as per original application 25/00694/HOU.Reason: This is required by Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

Prior to beneficial occupation of the development to which this permission relates, any windows or rooflights at the first floor level or above in both, side elevations shall be constructed so that no part of the framework less than 1.7m above finished floor level shall be openable. Any part below that level shall be fitted with and permanently retained in obscure glazing to a minimum of level 3 on the standard scale. Any film used to achieve the requisite obscurity level shall be non-perishable, tamper-proof, and shall be replaced immediately in the event that it ceases to result in obscurity to level 3.Reason: To ensure satisfactory living conditions for neighbouring occupiers, in accordance with policy D3 of the London Plan 2021 and policy DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

Prior to beneficial occupation of the development to which this permission relates, privacy screening, 1.8m in height as measured from the floor level adjacent to the screen, shall be erected along the both sides of the balcony. Aside from essential fixings, the screen(s) shall be constructed entirely of obscure glazing to a minimum of level 3 on the standard scale. Any film used to achieve the requisite obscurity level shall be non-perishable, tamper-proof, and shall be replaced immediately in the event that it ceases to result in obscurity to level 3.Reason: To ensure satisfactory living conditions for neighbouring occupiers, in accordance with policy D3 of the London Plan 2021 and policy DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

The development hereby approved shall be carried out in accordance with the Fire Safety Statement hereby approved and thereafter maintained.Reason: In the interests of Fire Safety and to ensure the safety of all building users in accordance with Policy D12 (Fire safety) of the London Plan 2021.

Prior to the beneficial occupation of the development to which this permission relates, the proposed ground floor, floor-to-ceiling window located in the east side elevation of the single-storey rear extension (facing No. 15 Pine Walk) shall be fitted in its entirety with manufactured obscure glass to a minimum of level 3 on the standard scale. The use of applied obscure window film is not permitted. Furthermore, no part of the window framework less than 1.7m above the internal finished floor level shall be openable. The window shall be permanently retained in this condition thereafter.Reason: To safeguard the privacy and amenities of the occupiers of the adjoining property at No. 15 Pine Walk, having regard to the difference in land levels, in accordance with policy D3 of the London Plan 2021 and policy DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.
